title: Weather & Agricultural Advisory
subtitle: Hyperlocal weather forecasts and crop-growth stage advisories for Assam farmers.
irrigationTitle: Water Management for Barak River Basin
irrigationDesc: With relative humidity at 82% and mild overcast skies, water evaporation from paddy fields is low. Maintain 2-3 cm standing water in Sali rice fields; hold back additional pump irrigation.
sprayingDesc: Wind speed is calm at 8 km/h. Suitable for foliar spray of organic neem oil (NSKE 5%) or zinc sulphate. Cease spraying if evening mist clouds thicken.
harvestDesc: Ensure harvested grains are covered with tarpaulin sheets overnight to avoid moisture absorption from early winter morning dews.
